name: plan-mode
description: Ask for a plan to add per-client rate limiting to the router, with the plan agent selected. The plan must name the real dispatch point and the real handler modules; nothing on disk may change.
proves: that a read-only planning mode exists, can be selected, produces a concrete plan grounded in the actual files, and cannot write
prompt:
Plan how to add per-client rate limiting to this service: at most N requests per client id per minute, applied to every route, returning HTTP 429 when the limit is exceeded.

Give me the plan only — which files you would create or change and what each change does, as numbered steps. Do not implement anything.
